profile.headline: Founder, Engineer, Creative | ex-Slack SWE
profile.summary:
After nearly nine years building software at Slack — from early hyper-growth through IPO and acquisition — I stepped away to expand what building meant to me.As an early engineer, I helped build products used by millions and was awarded multiple software patents. 

I entered tech in 2015, during a moment of rapid growth and cultural optimism, and had a front-row seat to how ideas become infrastructure — and how narratives shape industries.

In 2024, I founded Root Access Media to develop original film and television projects at the intersection of technology and storytelling. I’m currently developing scripted work inspired by conversations with founders, operators, and leaders building in the AI era — stories about ambition, craft, second acts, and the systems we create.

Before tech, I trained as a performer and storyteller at Northwestern University, studying Theatre, Radio/TV/Film, and Political Science. I never planned to become an engineer — I taught myself to code and landed at Slack when someone offered me a seat on the rocket ship. That nonlinear path now informs everything I build.

Today, I work at the intersection of AI, narrative, and systems — writing, developing film and television, and exploring conversations with builders shaping what comes next.I’m especially interested in connecting with people in technology, media, and IP development who care about craft, reinvention, and building enduring things.

positions.title: Founder, AI Consultant, Software Engineer
positions.description: Tetherlight.AI is an AI consultancy studio I founded to assist startups and small businesses with AI adoption and digital transformation. Focus areas include: AI product development, architecture, enterprise sales strategy and positioning, prototyping, systems design, AI integration, and strategic technical direction.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Consulting · Full-Stack Development · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Fundraising · Creative Strategy · Product Design · Product Management

positions.title: CEO, Founder & Producer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles | San Francisco | New York · Hybrid
positions.description:
Root Access Media is a research and development studio studying how people build, adopt, and recover from technology — converting primary-source insights from founders, operators, and investors into narrative IP (film, television, podcast).
• Conducting original research interviews with female VCs, founders, CEOs, and operators about power dynamics in tech — primary source material for scripted and documentary projects.
• Developing The Startup Infirmary, a podcast on how founders navigate and recover from failure; building guest pipeline across the startup and venture ecosystem.
• Co-developing a scripted drama series with a Hollywood producer (whose credits include a landmark film about women navigating systems of power), rooted in original research across startups, venture, and Big Tech.
• Pitching a development fund to bring tech-industry capital and relationships to narrative projects about the AI era; building investor pipeline with VCs and angels.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Leadership · Fundraising · Generative AI · Creative Writing · Media Production · Creative Strategy · Creative Concept Design · Intellectual Property · Innovation Development · Storytelling · Story Pitching · Story Consulting

positions.title: Co-Founder + Product Lead
positions.description:
Left Slack to build. Explored three ventures across eight months — conducting the kind of zero-to-one product work that most engineers never touch.
• Agentic AI for MedSpas + AI evidence review automation for a DA's office: conducted scores of user interviews and market research across both verticals; built working prototypes; developed pitch decks and financial models; secured angel investor introductions; pitched Sequoia, South Park Commons, and YC advisors; applied to multiple AI accelerators.
• AI-native property management platform: led customer discovery through interviews with real estate agents, property inspectors, and homeowners; conducted VC landscape research; connected team with venture investors.
• Influencer startup advisory: evaluated co-founder fit via YC co-founder framework; conducted international market research; advised on go-to-market strategy.
positions.insights: Skills: Start-up Ventures · Start-up Leadership · Fundraising

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Product Prototyping) - Fullstack, Scouts Team
positions.description:
Scouts is a pre-PM flex team that prototypes product ideas for Slack's C-Suite. Engineers own product end-to-end — user research, roadmap, metrics, launch, and stakeholder communication. Scouts projects became Slack's most-loved new features: Huddles, Clips, Later, and IA4.
• Drove Later — now one of Slack's four core sidebar tabs — from earliest prototype through public GA (2023). Later replaced Saved Items and launched to 2.5x the usage; it launched to 4.4M MAU and became Slack's 3rd most-viewed synthetic page.
• Owned the full product lifecycle without a PM title: fielded all user feedback from internal beta; translated insights into product decisions; defined and tracked success metrics; built dashboards ensuring every major decision was data-informed.
• Managed a CEO-directed product pivot in summer 2022 — team designed, built, and shipped a new version of Later in two weeks. Stewart Butterfield gave the prototype some of the most positive feedback a Principal engineer and SVP had ever seen from him.
• Served as point person for cross-functional launch: partnered with PMs, Marketing, and Customer Success; sole owner of post-launch bug triage and categorization; managed the entire fix pipeline.
• Presented product direction to the CEO, CPO, SVP of Product, SVP of Engineering, and SVP of Design; directed scope and delivery for a team of Principal and Staff-level engineers despite holding a Senior Engineer title.
• Implemented Slack AI Channel Summaries: full-stack LLM-powered feature using Slack AI endpoints, invite flows, and RTM events; drove feature tradeoff discussions with product and design.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend, Product Security Foundations
positions.description:
• Founded Slack's Security Champions program: developed curriculum, recruited cohort, pitched to CSO and Directors of Security; transitioned ownership post-launch. Also co-led a comprehensive assessment of Slack's authentication infrastructure compiled into a report for the CTO.
• Led Secure Library Adoption project — organized 15+ engineers across the org, reached 100% of OKR milestone; built AWS Endpoint Security Scanner in Go; evangelized security testing initiative resulting in 121 tests running on all backend PRs.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend, Platform
positions.description:
• Backend tech lead for App Management APIs: designed and shipped public APIs for Slack admins ahead of schedule — credited by Platform GM for IBM going wall-to-wall with Slack.
• Co-built Google Calendar Slack app on Built By Slack infrastructure; first product engineer to implement Prometheus monitoring in a Built By Slack app; presented work at Women Who Code Toronto (2019).

positions.title: Associate > Software Engineer - Enterprise & Monetization
positions.description:
• One of the original 8 engineers on the Enterprise team; one of Slack's first 200 employees.
• Feature lead on Automated Dunning System (U.S. Patent No. 10,572,116), GDPR/tax compliance billing, Mobile Device Management backend, and Slack's sales tax system.
• Sales Tax - Feature lead, designed and implemented Slack’s sales tax system, served as direct
contact for vendors and internal cross-functional accounting and finance teams.
• Enterprise Search API - optimized enterprise api for cross-workspace search before we had a real
search team.
• Mentored a QA engineer into a backend engineer; developed and led a 10-week Hack/HHVM workshop curriculum with Keith Adams (inventor of Hack at Facebook).

positions.title: Software Engineering Fellow
positions.description:
Hackbright Academy is the leading software engineering school for women.  Admissions to the 12 week, full-time intensive is highly selective, and aims to increase female representation in tech by equipping each cohort with in-demand technical skills, mentorship, and community.

As a Hackbright Fellow I am currently learning Python, JavaScript, Jinja, jQuery, Flask, SQLite, PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Bash, HTML, CSS, AJAX, and Git. The curriculum incorporates Agile development practices and pair programming with lectures, daily assignments, labs, and four weeks dedicated to coding a personal project. I loved every moment of the Hackbright Academy experience, and am honored to be a part of this inspiring community! #changetheratio 

Check out my projects so far at @github.com/carly

positions.title: Assistant Director
positions.description:
Freedom For All is a nonprofit founded by Katie Ford, former CEO of Ford Models, whose mission is to end human trafficking and modern day slavery. FFA works internationally with partner organizations in Brazil, India, Africa, the United States, and the Philippines to create systemic solutions to human trafficking and free people from modern day slavery.

As Assistant Director of FFA I worked directly with the CEO and managed all aspects of non-profit operations, including but not limited to: planning and coordinating fundraising galas, bookkeeping for all foundation related financials, allocating grants, developing partnerships, composing CEO correspondence and speeches, and maintaining the website and social media.

positions.title: Director of Media Relations
positions.description:
After working as assistant to the CEO for several months, I was promoted to this position with Freedom For All as the foundation prepared to launch an international campaign to raise awareness of human trafficking. As the Director of Media Relations, I worked with a team of award winning directors, cinematographers, and media professionals over five months in developing the strategic release of three anti-trafficking PSA short films. 

I spearheaded our publicity efforts by developing relationships with key social media influencers,and implementing an international media campaign. The PSAs gained 400,000+ views in our first week of release and were featured by Upworthy, YouTube, and TED.
Additionally, I increased twitter engagement by 617%, and accumulated 1000+ new followers in three months, making an inactive account on par with media accounts of top anti-trafficking foundations.

positions.title: Assistant to CEO of Freedom For All
positions.description: As assistant to Katie Ford, CEO of Freedom For All, I was responsible for organizing all of her personal and professional life. I  wrote and managed her professional correspondence, maintained her schedule, appointments, travel, bookkeeping for personal and business related financials, and event planned private parties in New York City and The Hamptons. After I was promoted to a position with Freedom For All, I continued to maintain these additional responsibilities.

positions.title: Marketing and Recruitment
positions.description:
Urbansitter.com is a San Francisco based babysitting startup. As the young company prepared to break into the Midwest market, I worked directly with the Chicago General Manager to develop strategies for on boarding Chicago mothers and babysitters to the platform. 

Additionally, I led the grassroots recruitment efforts by reaching out to local businesses, planning and supporting the General Manager with meet ups for mothers and babysitters, and hosting on-campus events at Colleges and Universities.

positions.title: Professional Actor, Singer, Dancer
positions.description:
As a freshly minted Northwestern University trained singer, dancer, actor, I was fortunate to have the opportunity to pursue my passion for theater as a professional actress in the acclaimed Chicago Theater community. I was represented by Gray Talent Group, Chicago's most sought after talent agency with offices in NYC and LA, and supported myself as an actress for almost two years. 

Accomplishments include: working full-time singing, dancing and acting in 5 Broadway Musicals at several prestigious Chicago Equity Theaters. Contracts ran 3-6 months with 8 shows a week. 
I also was invited to perform the lead role in the opening ceremony of the 2012 Joseph Jefferson Equity Theater Awards, co-starring with a Tony Nominee and a SNL Alumnus.
